changelog:
• Fixed movie playback issue — movies were playing short app update video instead of actual content due to server database corruption.
• Fixed subtitle loading — subtitles now properly fetch by extracting resourceId from video streams.
• Improved subtitle language names — now displays "English", "Hindi", "Spanish" instead of "en", "hi", "es".
• Fixed H5 fallback referer — works correctly with new numeric ID format.
• Enhanced subtitle debugging — added detailed logging for better troubleshooting.
